text_block_list.text:
I rush Seiun Sky to the infirmary after
she gets
hurt during training.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ngh! I've really done it this time...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I messed up this bad! Me
of all
people!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nya-ha-ha! I'll be fine. Don't go fretting
now.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well... Maybe I will, maybe I won't.
choice_data_list: ちゃんと安静にしてくれる？

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I think I might take it easy for the time
being, at
least.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it just won't feel right messing
with you
when you're so concerned and
whatnot.

Seiun Sky, perhaps due to the severity
of her
injury, actually commits to her
recuperation this
time.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. I'll do my best to rest and
recover...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: As if! Time to make my escape!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna be stuck in bed, but I
might be out
of options this time.

Seiun Sky, perhaps due to the severity
of her
injury, commits to her recovery.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hold on now... It doesn't hurt too bad. I
can work
with this!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yep, positive. I think I can manage some
light
running. And it's not so serious I
need to stay off
my feet.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Told you I'd be back to normal if I just
slacked off
like always. Catch ya later!

Staying true to her word, Seiun Sky ends
up fully
recovering from her injury at her
own leisurely
pace.
